_: The invented world every frame of the promos and walkthroughs is filmed in. Nothing here is a real person, computer, path, business or agent. The seeder (capture/seed.js) builds the sandbox offices from it; the videos (src/) draw the diagrams from it.

computers.name: DESK

computers.name: MINI

computers.name: LAPTOP

projects.line: A web app that plans a vegetable garden.
The website for a neighbourhood bakery.

agents.name: Iris
agents.title: The Research Desk
agents.line: Reads everything on a topic and hands back one page with the sources.
jokes: I read the footnotes so you do not have to.
Knock knock. Who's there? Sources. Sources who? Sources, plural. Always plural.
I'd tell you a joke about citations, but I would need three of them.

agents.name: Quill
agents.title: The Content Desk
agents.line: Turns your notes into posts, newsletters and pages, in your voice.
jokes: I'd write you a joke, but the first draft is always too long.
Knock knock. Who's there? Comma. Comma who? Comma back later, I'm editing.
I don't have writer's block. I have editor's opinions.
